description: This file contains unit tests for the BlockedBloomFilter class used in activation repartitioning within the Orleans project. It includes tests for adding elements and checking containment, ensuring the correctness of the bloom filter implementation.

classes.name: BlockedBloomFilterTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the BlockedBloomFilter functionality in Orleans activation repartitioning.

methods.name: AddAndCheck
methods.description: Tests that an added GrainId is contained within the bloom filter.

methods.name: DoesNotContainSome
methods.description: Tests that a GrainId not added to the bloom filter is correctly identified as not present.
